doc: A kind of road (design/planner.md, Roads): its surface and what stands at its edges by rule (a half's stall, bench, crates, planter, or cart; lamp and sign posts; planters and crates against buildings; a quay or bank at water), as a config entry, so a lane, a high street, and a market are data. A road never builds a fence or a centre: fences are fence_v1's, a square's centre a civic building's.

fields.name: surface
fields.doc: What it is paved with (moss stones: stepping stones in moss; sand; a boardwalk of planks on piles).

fields.name: paved
fields.doc: How much of a cell the paving covers toward open land (1 to its edge; less leaves a verge).

fields.name: verge
fields.doc: What lies between the paving and open land.

fields.name: half
fields.doc: What an edge piece in a half holds, where the plan gives the cell a half: a market stall against its edge, a bench, crates and barrels, a planter, or a hand cart.

fields.name: half_color
fields.doc: A stall's awning, a cart's paint, a bench's cushions.

fields.name: lamps
fields.doc: How often a cell beside a building or open land has a lamp post on a corner, 0 to 1.

fields.name: signs
fields.doc: A sign post at one junction cell in four (three or four ways), its arms pointing along them.

fields.name: clutter
fields.doc: How often a building's side or back has crates or a barrel against it, 0 to 1 (inside the edge's strip, never across the way).

fields.name: planters
fields.doc: How often a building front has a planter against it, 0 to 1 (inside the edge's strip).

fields.name: quay
fields.doc: Its edges to water are a stone quay with bollards (else a bank).
